notes.title: Meow Mission is Now Available on Linux!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, this is Accelix!

[h3]We’re thrilled to announce that Meow Mission is now playable on [b]Linux[/b]! 🎉[/h3]

Thanks to your amazing support and enthusiasm, we were able to deliver Linux support sooner than expected. Now you can enjoy adorable adventures with your cat companions even more freely on Linux! 🐾

Since this is our first-ever Linux build, there may be unexpected bugs or issues. [b][i]If you run into any problems while playing, please let us know by posting on the Steam Discussion Boards.[/i][/b] We’ll check your feedback promptly and work on improvements as quickly as possible.

Your input is invaluable in helping us create a better gaming experience. We can’t wait to hear your thoughts and stories!

Thank you for your support! ❤️

notes.title: Meow Mission Patch Note #3
notes.notes:
[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

[b]New Features[/b]
[list][*][b]Linux Support:[/b] Meow Mission is now available on Linux! If you encounter any bugs or issues, please let us know via the Steam discussions board. This is our first release for Linux, so your feedback is invaluable.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*][b]Achievement Completion Issue:[/b] Fixed a bug where certain achievements wouldn’t unlock properly.
[*][b]P Button Spam Bug:[/b] Resolved an issue where spamming the P button on the start screen caused unexpected behavior.
[*][b]Bonus Layer Arrow Bug:[/b] Corrected an issue where the arrow moved incorrectly when selecting a bonus layer in level selection.

[*] Bonus Mission: Playable up to Mission B4 [/list]
